day_shape: 79 items: IAEA Board passes Quad-backed Iran resolution with Russia/China dissent, 22-country joint statement on Iranian state threats and HAYI attacks, Trump threatens Iran power plants and bridges, IDF confirms Ramat David airbase hit, OFAC publishes Iran GLs U and V.

threads.label: IAEA Board passes Iran resolution
threads.summary: France, Germany, the UK and US (the Quad) introduced and passed a resolution at the IAEA Board of Governors on Iran's NPT Safeguards Agreement compliance. Iran's Vienna mission called the vote 'weak' and political; Iran, China and Russia issued a joint statement opposing the resolution and calling for diplomacy.

threads.label: 22-country statement on Iranian state threats
threads.summary: The US State Department and UK FCDO released a joint statement signed by 22 countries condemning Iranian security service threat activity in Europe, North America and Australia and HAYI-claimed attacks. The Jerusalem Post reported the statement; Albania's PM separately alleged an Iranian cyber operation amplifying domestic protests.

threads.label: Trump infrastructure threats and Iran response
threads.summary: Trump told Fox News the US may strike Iran's power plants and bridges, saying Iran is 'tapping the United States along' in talks. President Pezeshkian responded on X calling the threats 'a sign of desperation'; Hormozgan's judiciary said the prior Sirik water-facility strike constitutes a war crime.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear talks progress reported
threads.summary: VP JD Vance said a long-term US-Iran nuclear agreement is nearing fruition and could come in weeks or months; the New York Times also reported progress on several issues including the nuclear file. Former Mossad and Israeli defence figures publicly criticised the negotiating approach.

threads.label: IDF strikes across southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck Hezbollah operatives and infrastructure in Tyre and other southern Lebanon areas, issued evacuation warnings for Ansariyah, Ghassanieh and Homin al-Fauqa, and intercepted a Hezbollah drone over Shlomi. Lebanese media reported at least 13 killed including two in a Sidon drone strike; Erdogan said the strikes threaten Turkey.

threads.label: Ramat David airbase damage confirmed
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed Israeli Air Force's Ramat David Airbase was hit by a missile fragment during Iran's ballistic missile fire earlier this week, with minor damage to a warehouse and no injuries. Preliminary findings point to falling fragments following an interception.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and Iran domestic enforcement
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages on national unity and naming the 'American presence' as the region's main insecurity factor, and announced appointments to the Islamic Seminary Services Centre. Iran International reported a dissident cleric sentenced to six years and defrocked; the Jerusalem Post reported assets seized from footballer Ali Karimi.
